ops.title: cc-review daemon restart changes its port and kills every review URL
ops.body: Installing a cc-review release restarts its daemonkit daemon on a new HTTP port; tailnet review URLs embed the port, so every cached URL 404s and callers re-run cc-review start, which re-resolves the PR stack over GitHub GraphQL. With the account's GraphQL quota exhausted (Oct 27 6:22 to 6:49 AM) every dashboard review failed although all reviews were still open. The drive dashboard falls back to the open review's slug (cc-review list, by scope) on the current port (cc-review status) since yasyf/cc-skills#792. Install cc-review releases when GraphQL quota is healthy (gh api graphql rateLimit).
